people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Kedar
people.line: A son of Ishmael and a nomadic tribe

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar’s tents, like Solomon’s curtains.
translations.bsb: I am dark, yet lovely, O daughters of Jerusalem, like the tents of Kedar, like the curtains of Solomon.
translations.kjv: I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.
translations.asv: I am black, but comely, Oh ye daughters of Jerusalem, As the tents of Kedar, As the curtains of Solomon.
